trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 40-50 degree angle at the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels on the right lobe; left lobe shows smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a linear-convex sweep tapering to a sharp distal point; right lobe exhibits a broad, rounded convex sweep with a thickened terminus.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A cluster of five distinct, circular gray spots (pixel clusters) located on the distal posterior region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned gray linear disruptions visible on the medial-proximal surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular U-shaped indentation located on the outer third of the right lobe trailing edge, distinct from natural serration.
